correctness.rationale: Unitary product Fourier diagonalization is exact; nonzero root-of-unity chord differences have collinear directions only when the two index sums are divisible by the coprime cycle orders. Their ranges force both sums to be precisely their orders, which yields unique conjugate two-mode collisions. The sine formula is necessary and sufficient. PBH rank for all eigenspaces gives simultaneous divisibility as the necessary and sufficient pair-site condition; adjacent and prime-order corollaries are immediate. A separate 82-digit checker passed 4,248,701 supplementary finite assertions.
